name: slide-swap
title: Slide Swap
description: Scenes swap on one canvas, never overlapping: the old scene is shoved off under power and the next one springs in and brakes into place. Plays three scenes (A, B, C). Built-in placeholder scenes A, B and C (the three .ssw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it with your own scenes, replace the contents of those panels (each holds for 70 frames) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Slide-deck style content with several scenes that should swap crisply.
UI walkthroughs where scenes slide in like screens.
avoidWhen: You need the scenes to overlap or crossfade.
Cinematic pieces that want depth rather than flat slides.
author: Remocn

variables.label: In distance
variables.description: How far the incoming scene starts away, as a fraction of the frame size.

variables.label: Out distance
variables.description: How far the outgoing scene is shoved, as a fraction of the frame size.

variables.label: Slide frames
variables.description: Frames (at 30 fps) the entrance slide lasts.
